detail.title: Intex Beast Pro 20X Soundbar 20W Powerful Sound
detail.overview: Experience powerful and immersive audio with the Intex Beast Pro 20X Soundbar , designed to elevate your entertainment anytime, anywhere. With 20W powerful output and 360° surround sound , enjoy rich, room-filling audio for music, movies, and gaming. The soundbar features dual 52mm drivers that deliver enhanced bass and crystal-clear sound. Add a vibrant touch to your setup with multimode RGB LED lights , creating a dynamic party atmosphere. Stay connected effortlessly with Bluetooth v5.4 , ensuring stable and fast pairing. With multiple playback options including USB, AUX, TF card, and Bluetooth , you have complete flexibility to enjoy your favorite content. The TWS pairing feature allows you to connect two speakers for a more powerful stereo experience. Designed for convenience, it comes with a Type-C charging port and offers up to 5 hours of playback , making it perfect for both indoor and outdoor use.
